messages.content: Please check which smart light is in the living_room, identify it, confirm its current status, and also check the current time in America/New_York. Then set that living room light to on with brightness 70 and make sure the brightness change is actually applied. After that, find the living room smart lock, set its state to lock using PIN 2468, and then look up the contact info for alice. Prepare a high priority app alert with the exact message “Living room light and lock routine completed successfully.” Finally, take a snapshot of the /ops/iot-routines workspace named living-room-routine-snapshot and send the notification to alice through the app channel.
